comparability_label: MATCHED_BUDGET_ENCODER_REFERENCE (shared post_local + same raw OGB table + same graph; encoders differ in derived inputs and computation)
interpretation: The point estimate exceeds the 2% reference, but the pre-registered signal condition (bootstrap 95% CI entirely below 0) fails; the Valid advantage is not robust at 420 molecules and is concentrated in the molecules where A has the largest errors. This is not a claim that the gap disappeared.
notes: Single seed, one training unit for B; A is a read-only reuse of a completed 360-epoch run.
The encoder-level difference cannot be attributed to iterative message passing alone: input derivations and structure scope also differ.
